{
  "correction_rules": [
    "Adjust forecasts downward when sentiment history shows low positivity (0.00) and model overestimates prices.",
    "Reduce forecast magnitude when recent true outcomes show sharp downward corrections after spikes.",
    "Increase forecast sensitivity to recent low prices (e.g., <65) when sentiment is neutral or negative.",
    "Apply mean reversion bias: if forecast is >75 and true outcome is <70, reduce forecast by 5-10%.",
    "When sentiment history includes 0.50 or 0.67, anticipate upward momentum and slightly increase forecast horizon.",
    "Avoid over-optimism in early forecast periods (e.g., first 5 days) — model tends to overestimate when sentiment is flat.",
    "If true outcome is consistently below forecast (e.g., 3+ consecutive days), apply a 3-5% downward correction to next forecast.",
    "For high sentiment (0.67+), model tends to underreact — increase forecast by 2-5% to align with sentiment-driven momentum."
  ]
}
